subject.title: feat(agentmail): add official external channel plugin

question: Should OpenClaw officially own and publish this AgentMail-specific channel and its supporting shared runtime contracts, or should AgentMail maintain the channel externally through ClawHub/npm?
rationale: Current VISION.md favors externally maintained optional plugins and presently rejects commercial-service integrations outside model providers, while this branch proposes an OpenClaw-owned package and broad shared delivery contracts.

options.title: Externalize the channel
options.body: Publish the channel from an AgentMail or contributor repository and retain only separately reviewed, generally useful SDK seams in OpenClaw core.

options.title: Sponsor official ownership
options.body: Assign a long-term OpenClaw owner, accept the shared contract expansion, and require current-head live security, upgrade, packaging, and delivery proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Close or defer the branch if neither external ownership nor sustained official maintenance is available.

recommendation.title: Externalize the channel
recommendation.body: Publish the channel from an AgentMail or contributor repository and retain only separately reviewed, generally useful SDK seams in OpenClaw core.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans official plugin ownership, VISION.md product boundaries, and shared outbound architecture where this person has substantial recent history.
